non_blocking_findings.summary: parse_component_policy selects the first type==resourceOrigin candidate without enforcing that exactly one resourceOrigin component exists or that the chosen component is the ref://resource-origin owner referenced by the chain. If the component registry ever returns multiple resourceOrigin components with divergent configurations/versions, preflight could accept a component that is not the deployed owner.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: run-two-viewer.py parse_component_policy: next(value for value in components if value.get('type')=='resourceOrigin'); no count or ref-identity binding; offline probe 'two_ro_first_ok_second_bad' accepted the first matching entry while a second divergent entry was present. Current deployment evidence shows a single shared owner (components count 1, pipeline-fact-review 'a single shared ref://resource-origin owner'), so this is not exploitable today.
non_blocking_findings.resolution: Optional hardening: require exactly one resourceOrigin candidate (or a declared component id/name) and/or bind the selected component to the chain's ref://resource-origin root before accepting preflight.

non_blocking_findings.summary: preflight.json records existingTraffic.knownLocalMpvProcesses: 0 as a fixed constant even though the collector never enumerates local mpv processes. This can be misread as an observed fact rather than an assertion.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: preflight() record: 'existingTraffic': {'knownLocalMpvProcesses': 0, 'otherHosts': 'unknown'}; no mpv enumeration exists in the collector.
non_blocking_findings.resolution: Label the field as 'not_measured'/null or add a real local-process scan; otherwise the evidence reviewer should read it as an assertion, not a measurement.

non_blocking_findings.summary: crossViewer.requestedRegions for viewer-b carries a placeholder requestedIndex ('derived from runtime segment timeline') instead of the numeric index derived from start 600 that design section 8 describes.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: cross_viewer_summary() viewer-b requestedIndex is a string; the segment index for 600 s must still be derived by the evidence reviewer from open counts/timeline.
non_blocking_findings.resolution: Either compute and record the derived index in the summary or keep the placeholder but explicitly mark the derivation as review-time work (currently implied by the string).

non_blocking_findings.summary: readback_policy records nodeCount/connectionCount but does not hard-gate them against the approved 52/69 shape; a chain that changed elsewhere while preserving version, roots and both TTLs would still pass preflight. chainSha256 is preserved so the change remains detectable in evidence.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: readback_policy() sets policy['nodeCount']/'connectionCount' for the record; preflight checks do not compare them to 52/69. Offline probe confirmed acquire/root checks fire on TTL and root mismatches, which are the gated state values required by the design.
non_blocking_findings.resolution: Optional: assert nodeCount==52 and connectionCount==69 in checks, or document that non-TTL/version/root chain drift is review-time detectable via chainSha256.

non_blocking_findings.summary: The live /api/v1/components envelope and the presence of configuration.maxRetainedBytes at the parser's expected path remain unconfirmed offline. The parser is fail-closed on unknown envelopes (e.g. archived {resourceOriginVersion, nodeCount, configuration, globalNames} summary shape returns type/version None and aborts), so the risk is an unnecessary abort, not a false acceptance.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Offline probe of old_summary_shape returned type=None version=None; wrapped_data also returned None/None. Implementer's own remaining question lists the deployed component endpoint envelope as an open item.
non_blocking_findings.resolution: Live preflight must confirm the actual /api/v1/components body shape before the gate run; if it differs from the handled envelopes, the parser or the endpoint expectation must be reconciled first.
